d: The horrifying story of a computer engineer who lured a 14-year-old school boy to his flat and killed him.
The Sunderland Strangler, Steven Grieveson, killed four teenage boys in the early 90s.
John Wayne Gacy murdered 33 boys and young men during a six-year period in the 1970s. He hid the bodies of his victims in the walls of his suburban home.
A dangerous sexual predator murdered one young woman just days after his release from prison.
Between 1989 and 1992 in East Germany, Wolfgang Schmidt, known as the Beast of Beelitz, murdered four women and a baby.
John Sweeney killed two of his former girlfriends and then dumped their dismembered bodies in canals in Rotterdam and London. He was sentenced in 2011 and was given a whole life tariff.
Peter Moore was a sadistic serial killer who killed and mutilated four men in North Wales in 1995. The local cinema owner had an obsession with Nazis and sadomasochistic sex.
A cult killer portrayed himself as a pillar of the community, but his story was deeply sinister.
